blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Humanoid agents in everyday environments are expected to react to diverse cues as humans do, with semantically appropriate and physically executable behaviors. Existing cue-driven reaction generation methods support only a narrow range of cue modalities and are limited to purely kinematic generation, leaving the resulting reactions susceptible to physical artifacts. To this end, we present MixReact, the first unified framework for physics-based reactive humanoid control from text, audio, and video cues, integrating a Discrete--Continuous Mixture of Transformers (DisCo-MoT) for state prediction with a History-aware Action Transformer (HAT) for physical execution. DisCo-MoT couples a discrete masked-modeling branch with a continuous autoregressive diffusion branch via one-way mixture attention within a MoT architecture. Guidance from discrete context mitigates collapse into averaged behaviors in one-to-many reaction generation, while direct prediction in continuous state space bypasses the decoding bottleneck of discrete representations. HAT then maps the predicted next state and observed execution history to executable actions, enabling robust closed-loop control in physics-based simulation. Experiments across all three modalities demonstrate consistent improvements over the baselines in fidelity, diversity, and physical consistency, while ablations validate the complementary contributions of the components. Our code will be released to facilitate future research. Project page: https://binlee26.github.io/MixReact_Page/
blocks.zh: 日常环境中的人体毒剂预计将像人类一样,对各种提示作出反应,其行为具有明显的适宜性和可执行性。 现有的提示驱动反应生成方法只支持范围狭窄的提示模式,并且仅限于纯粹的动能生成,使得由此产生的反应容易受到物理文物的影响. 为此,我们提出MixReact,这是从文字,音频和视频提示中实现基于物理的反应性人体控制的第一个统一框架,将Discrete-Continentive mixture of Transformers(DisCo-MoT)用于状态预测与具有历史认识的动作变形器(HAT)用于物理执行. DisCo-MOT通过MOT架构内的单向混合物注意,将一个离散的蒙面模型分支与连续的自旋扩散分支对齐. 从离散上下文得到的指导减轻了在一对多反应生成中崩溃为平均行为,而连续状态空间中的直接预测则绕过离散表达的解码瓶颈. HAT随后将预测的下一个状态和观察到的执行历史映射到可执行的动作中,使得在基于物理的模拟中能够进行强力的闭路控制. 跨越所有三种模式的实验表明,在准确性、多样性和物理一致性方面,基线的不断改进,同时证实各组成部分的互补性贡献。 我们的代码将会被公布 以促进未来的研究。 项目页面:https://binlee26.github.io/MixReact_Page/ 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-09-02.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Humans rarely act in isolation. We step back when a dog lunges, raise an arm against an incoming ball, and nod or wave when someone greets us. Endowing humanoid agents with human-like responsiveness to everyday cues is a core challenge in computer vision, with applications spanning animation, gaming, VR/AR, and embodied AI.
blocks.zh: 人类很少孤立行动. 我们退后,当一只狗肺上,举起一只手臂来对付一球,当有人向我们问好时点头或挥手. 赋予人造物剂对日常提示具有类似人性的反应,是计算机视觉中的一项核心挑战,应用包括动画,游戏,VR/AR,并包含AI.

blocks.en: Most reaction generation methods [ 26 , 8 , 13 , 84 , 76 , 66 , 3 , 41 , 49 , 14 , 28 ] condition on a partner’s body trajectory. This confines reactions to human–human interaction and presumes clean 3D motion of the counterpart. Recent work broadens this scope: HERO [ 86 ] introduces video-driven reaction generation, extending interactions to animals and environmental events, while NOUS [ 98 ] improves the correspondence between visual observations and generated reactions. In parallel, ReactMotion [ 44 ] supports text- and audio-driven reactions through ReactMotionNet, a large-scale dataset pairing speaker utterances with listener behaviors. Despite this progress, these works focus solely on kinematic generation without physical constraints, leaving generated motions prone to artifacts such as penetration, foot sliding, and floating that compromise realism and practical applicability. Moreover, each supports only a subset of cue modalities, and no existing framework unifies text-, audio-, and video-driven reactive control. To close both gaps, we introduce physics-based reactive humanoid control from multimodal cues (Fig. ): given a text, audio, or video cue, the goal is to control a humanoid to produce a semantically appropriate, physically plausible reaction.
blocks.zh: 大多数反应生成方法[26, 8, 13, 84, 76, 66, 3, 41, 49, 14, 28] 取决于伴侣的身体轨迹. 这限制了人类和人类的相互作用,并假定对应方的3D运动是干净的。 最近的工作拓宽了这个范围:HERO [86]引入了视频驱动的反应生成,将相互作用扩展到了动物和环境事件,而NOUS [98]则改善了视觉观测和生成的反应之间的对应. 同时,ReactMotion [44] 支持通过ReactMotionNet进行文字和音频驱动的反应,这个大型的数据集配对扬声器与听众行为. 尽管取得了这些进展,这些作品只注重动能生成而不受物理限制,使产生的运动容易被诸如穿透、脚滑和漂浮等文物所破坏,从而损害现实主义和实际适用性。 此外,每个模式只支持一个提示模式子集,没有现有的框架统一文本、音频和视频驱动的反应控制。 为了填补这两个空白,我们从多模式提示(图)中引入了基于物理的反应性人造物控制:如果一个文字、音频或视频提示,目标是控制一种人造物,从而产生出一种客观上适当的、物理上可信的反应。

blocks.en: The central challenge lies in the one-to-many mapping from cues to reactions: a greeting, for example, may elicit a wave, a nod, or a bow. Most existing physics-based methods [ 69 , 74 , 34 , 33 , 71 , 22 , 80 , 60 , 88 , 46 ] model behavior in continuous spaces, a formulation that may cause distinct reaction modes to blend into an averaged response under one-to-many cue-to-reaction mappings. Discrete token-based modeling [ 81 , 56 , 27 , 99 , 89 , 17 , 15 ] mitigates this collapse by sampling distinct reaction modes from categorical token distributions, but quantization-induced reconstruction errors compromise the fine-grained contact and balance information essential for physics-based execution. We observe that the two paradigms are complementary: which reaction to perform is naturally a discrete choice, while how to execute it requires precise detail.
blocks.zh: 中心挑战在于从提示到反应的一对一绘图:例如,问候可能会引起一波一波、一点头或一弓。 大多数现有的以物理为基础的方法[69, 74, 34, 33, 71, 22, 80, 60, 88, 46] 在连续空间中的模型行为,这种配方可能导致不同的反应模式在一对多提示-反应映射下融合成平均反应. 分散的以符号为基础的模型[81,56,27,99,89,17,15]通过从绝对符号分配中取样不同的反应模式来缓解这种崩溃,但量化引起的重建错误会损害对物理执行至关重要的精细的接触和平衡信息. 我们认为,这两个范式是相辅相成的:执行何种反应自然是一种离散的选择,而如何执行则需要精确的细节。

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose MixReact , a unified physics-based reactive control framework that takes text, audio, or video cues and drives a humanoid to produce physically plausible and semantically consistent reactions. At its core is a Dis crete– Co ntinuous M ixture o f T ransformers (DisCo-MoT), a novel state generation architecture that couples a discrete masked-modeling branch [ 57 , 4 , 15 , 55 , 38 ] with a continuous autoregressive diffusion branch [ 69 , 75 , 94 , 65 , 51 , 20 , 19 , 95 , 6 , 63 , 36 ] within a MoT [ 96 , 40 ] framework, as shown in Fig. 2 . Specifically, the discrete branch samples a complete reaction as a sequence of learned state tokens that serves as persistent global behavioral context. The continuous branch accesses this context through one-way mixture attention over key–value caches from the discrete branch’s intermediate Transformer layers, while keeping the discrete context independent of denoising features. Conditioned on this context and actual execution history, it autoregressively predicts future states in continuous space. This design mitigates mode collapse through guidance from the discrete context while directly modeling behavior in continuous space, thereby circumventing the reconstruction bottleneck associated with decoding tokenized representations [ 72 , 59 , 32 ] .
To enable robust physical execution, we introduce a H istory-aware A ction T ransformer (HAT) that maps the predicted next state and observed execution history to physically executable actions. This establishes a state-based interface between reaction generation and closed-loop control. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MixReact consistently outperforms the baselines in fidelity, diversity, and physical consistency.

blocks.en: DeepMimic [ 52 ] learns imitation policies from reference motions, AMP [ 54 ] introduces adversarial motion priors, and PHC [ 45 ] scales tracking with failure recovery. Reusable representations span continuous [ 53 , 73 , 80 , 68 , 11 , 46 ] and discrete [ 100 , 81 ] latent spaces for downstream control. PhysDiff [ 88 ] , InsActor [ 60 ] , and CLoSD [ 69 ] couple motion generation with physical execution. Complementary approaches explore language-directed control [ 29 ] , motion inpainting [ 64 , 67 ] , progressive policy distillation [ 30 ] , and diffusion-based control [ 71 , 90 , 74 , 22 , 82 , 34 , 33 ] . However, physics-based control of one-to-many reactions to everyday multimodal cues remains underexplored.
blocks.zh: DeepMimic [52] 从参考动议中学习出模仿政策,AMP [54] 引入对抗性动议前作,而PHC [45] 天平跟踪则带有故障恢复. 可重复使用的表示跨越连续[53、73、80、68、11、46]和离散[100、81]下游控制的潜在空间。 PhysDiff [88],InsActor [60],以及CLOSD [69] 夫妇运动生成与物理执行. 补充方法探索以语言为导向的控制[29],动画[64,67],渐进式政策分馏[30],并基于扩散的控制[71,90,74,22,82,34,33]. 然而,对日常多模式提示的一对多反应的物理控制仍然没有得到充分利用。

blocks.en: Reaction synthesis commonly conditions on a partner’s 3D motion [ 8 , 13 , 76 , 66 , 79 , 25 , 93 , 1 ] . Recent work broadens conditioning to RGB or egocentric video [ 86 , 98 , 91 ] , speaker utterances [ 44 ] , and spatial audio [ 78 , 77 , 50 ] . Online approaches employ causal generation [ 84 , 3 ] , reduce error accumulation through training on generated histories [ 12 ] , or incorporate others’ actions and scene geometry [ 83 ] . PhysReaction [ 41 ] and Human-X [ 26 ] support physical execution through dynamics-guided imitation and actor-aware tracking, respectively, but primarily require a partner’s 3D motion. Spatial-audio methods also demonstrate downstream physics-based tracking [ 78 , 50 ] . MixReact unifies text-, audio-, and video-driven reactions with closed-loop physical execution, without requiring a partner’s 3D motion, which is often difficult to acquire.
blocks.zh: 对伴侣3D运动的反应综合常见条件[8,13,76,66,79,25,93,1]. 最近的工作扩大了RGB或以自我为中心的视频[86、98、91]、扬声器[44]和空间音频[78、77、50]的条件。 在线方法采用因果生成法[84,3],通过对生成历史的培训来减少误差积累[12],或者纳入他人的行为和场景几何[83]. PhysReaction [41]和Human-X [26]分别通过动态制导仿真和演员-意识跟踪支持物理执行,但主要需要伴侣的3D运动. 空间-音频方法还展示了下游基于物理学的跟踪[78.,50]. MixReact统一了文本,音频,视频驱动的反应与闭路物理执行,而不需要伴侣的3D运动,这往往很难获得.

blocks.en: Transfusion [ 96 ] combines next-token prediction with denoising diffusion [ 20 , 65 , 51 ] in a shared Transformer. MoT [ 40 ] assigns modality-specific parameters while retaining global attention, with related architectures in LMFusion [ 62 ] and BAGEL [ 9 ] . Vision-language-action models constrain information flow through asymmetric attention [ 2 , 24 ] or specialist-to-generalist querying [ 85 ] . LLaMo [ 37 ] and MotionGPT3 [ 99 ] extend language models with MoT and continuous motion representations. DisCoRD [ 7 ] maps discrete tokens to continuous motion through rectified flow. DisCo-MoT instead couples discrete masked modeling [ 57 , 4 , 15 , 55 , 38 , 56 , 87 , 39 , 23 ] with continuous autoregressive diffusion [ 69 , 75 , 94 , 19 , 95 , 6 , 63 , 36 , 35 , 5 , 92 ] through one-way mixture attention, allowing a complete discrete reaction plan to guide continuous state prediction.

blocks.en: Given a text, audio, or video cue c m c_{m} , MixReact generates a semantically appropriate reaction and executes it in physics-based simulation (Fig. 2 ). The multimodal conditioning adapter (MCA) first constructs a semantic memory C C (Sec. 3.1 ), which conditions reaction state generation in the Discrete–Continuous Mixture of Transformers (DisCo-MoT; Sec. 3.2 ). The History-aware Action Transformer (HAT) then combines each denoised next state with observed execution history to generate an executable action (Sec. 3.3 ). Simulator feedback updates the execution history, closing the loop between reaction generation and physical control.

blocks.en: As shown in the left panel of Fig. 2 , DisCo-MoT couples discrete modeling of complete reactions with continuous prediction of state evolution. The discrete masked-modeling branch provides persistent behavior context, while the continuous diffusion branch predicts future states from this context and execution history. The branches maintain separate projections and feed-forward networks and communicate through one-way mixture attention.
blocks.zh: 如图2左面板所显示,DisCo-MOT夫妇用连续预测状态演化的完整反应的离散模型. 离散的遮盖模型分支提供持续的行为上下文,而持续的扩散分支从上下文和执行历史中预测出未来状态. 分支维持单独的预测和向导网络,并通过单向混合关注进行沟通.

blocks.en: To maintain behavioral consistency across prediction windows, the discrete branch represents a complete reaction as a sequence of state tokens. A pretrained, frozen VQ-VAE tokenizer [ 72 ] , with codebook size K K and temporal downsampling factor κ \kappa , maps a T T -frame state sequence to Z = ( z 1 , … , z N ) Z=(z_{1},\ldots,z_{N}) , where N = ⌈ T / κ ⌉ N=\lceil T/\kappa\rceil and z i ∈ { 1 , … , K } z_{i}\in\{1,\ldots,K\} . Following masked modeling [ 4 , 15 , 57 ] , the discrete branch predicts masked tokens conditioned on the unmasked tokens and semantic memory C C . At inference, it samples a complete token sequence once at the start of each rollout and retains it unchanged throughout execution. The continuous branch accesses this context through one-way mixture attention over key–value caches from the discrete branch’s intermediate Transformer layers, providing persistent global guidance across successive prediction windows. Within one-way mixture attention, discrete queries are masked from attending to continuous keys and values, while the continuous branch accesses the discrete branch’s key–value caches under stop-gradient, thereby preventing continuous denoising from disrupting the global behavioral structure.

As shown in Fig. 2 , for a rollout of T T frames, the discrete branch samples a complete sequence of N = ⌈ T / κ ⌉ N=\lceil T/\kappa\rceil state tokens once. Starting from a fully masked sequence, it performs R R sampling rounds, drawing token proposals from categorical distributions and committing them at randomly selected unresolved positions until the sequence is complete. Committed tokens remain fixed, and the completed sequence provides intermediate-layer key–value caches as persistent global context.
Then, the continuous branch performs 10 denoising steps conditioned on semantic memory C C , the cached discrete context, and the latest execution history H t d H_{t}^{d} . At control step t t , HAT maps the predicted next state s ^ t + 1 \hat{s}_{t+1} and history H t a H_{t}^{a} to an executable action a t a_{t} . Both histories are updated exclusively with simulator-returned states, closing the loop between state prediction and physical execution. blocks.en:
ReactMotion [ 44 ] generates text- and audio-driven listener reactions through preference-trained autoregressive modeling. HERO [ 86 ] generates video-driven reactions through intention-guided masked modeling, while NOUS [ 98 ] refines reactions with prototype-aligned visual features.
We construct ReactMotion++ [ 44 , 45 ] , HERO++ [ 86 , 45 ] , and NOUS++ [ 98 , 45 ] by executing their trajectories with the PHC tracking policy [ 45 ] in simulation.
We modify CLoSD [ 69 ] , which couples autoregressive diffusion planning with closed-loop tracking, to support text-, audio-, and video-driven reactions.

React Motion [44] 通过受偏好训练的自旋模型生成文本和音频驱动的听众反应. HERO [86]通过用意向制导的蒙面模型生成视频驱动的反应,而NOUS [98]则用原型相通的视觉特性来改进反应.

blocks.en: Tabs. 1 and 2 show consistent improvements across all modalities. Among the evaluated methods, MixReact achieves the lowest FID, highest multimodality, diversity closest to Phys-GT, and lowest floating and skating errors, with competitive jerk. On ViMo [ 86 ] , it reduces FID by 17.5% and skating error by 34.2% relative to NOUS++ [ 98 , 45 ] ; for audio-driven reactions, it reduces floating error by 40.9% over ReactMotion++ [ 44 , 45 ] . These gains reflect complementary discrete global guidance and continuous state prediction: persistent discrete context supports coherent, diverse reactions, while continuous prediction captures fine-grained state evolution beyond the decoding bottleneck of discrete representations. Unlike the “++” baselines, which track fixed kinematic references, MixReact conditions both future-state prediction and physics-based control on actual execution history. Compared with CLoSD [ 69 ] , which also incorporates simulation feedback, MixReact achieves greater conditional diversity and lower physical errors, further supporting the coupling of persistent discrete guidance with continuous adaptation.

blocks.en: Removing the discrete branch (Fig. 6 , second column) produces a restrained response and loss of balance in the video example. Across modalities, FID increases, while diversity and multimodality decrease, including a 38.4% drop in audio multimodality. These results support discrete planning for selecting distinct reactions to ambiguous cues and maintaining global context across prediction windows. Although text/audio floating and skating errors decrease, the accompanying reduction in behavioral variety underscores the limitations of physical metrics alone.
blocks.zh: 删除离散分支(图6,第二栏)会产生视频示例中受限的反应并失去平衡. 在各种模式中,FID增加,而多样性和多模式性则减少,包括音频多模式性下降38.4%。 这些结果有助于进行独立的规划,以选择对模棱两可的提示作出不同的反应,并维持整个预测窗口的全球背景。 虽然文字/音频浮出水面和花样滑冰出错减少,但伴随而来的行为多样性的减少凸显出仅物理度量的局限性.

blocks.en: Removing continuous denoising (Fig. 6 , third column) reduces arm-gesture amplitude in the text and video examples, worsens FID across modalities—including a 20.1% increase for video—and increases text/audio floating and skating errors. These findings support complementing discrete behavior selection with continuous state prediction, which captures fine-grained details of the predicted future humanoid states beyond the decoding bottleneck of discrete representations and adapts the selected behavior to actual execution through history conditioning across successive prediction windows.
blocks.zh: 删除连续去声(图6,第三栏)会减少文本和视频实例中的臂地振幅,使各种模式的FID恶化——包括视频增加20.1%,并会增加文本/音频浮出水面和花样滑冰出错。 这些发现支持以连续状态预测来补充离散行为选择,它捕捉到除离散表现的解码瓶颈之外预测出的未来人文状态的精细细节,并通过跨越相继预测窗口的历史条件来使所选择的行为适应实际执行.

blocks.en: Replacing one-way mixture attention with bidirectional attention increases both FID and jerk across all modalities, indicating reduced fidelity and smoothness. The visual results in Fig. 6 (fourth column) further illustrate the suboptimal behavior of the bidirectional variant. These support our one-way design, which protects discrete modeling from interference by continuous denoising, preserving global reaction structure to provide consistent guidance for continuous state prediction and physically plausible execution across prediction windows.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce MixReact for physics-based reactive humanoid control from text, audio, and video cues. DisCo-MoT couples discrete guidance with continuous prediction through one-way mixture attention; HAT enables robust closed-loop control. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved fidelity, diversity, and physical consistency. We hope this work inspires further research in reaction generation and advances the development of humanoid agents that interact naturally with the world.

blocks.en: 10.1 User Study
blocks.zh: 10.1 用户研究

blocks.en: We organize two separate rating rounds for baseline comparisons and ablation studies, both evaluated by the same 20 participants. In each round, we randomly select 30 cues per modality from the test set, yielding 90 cues spanning text, audio, and video. For each cue, reactions are presented together in randomized order under anonymous method labels, with synchronized playback to facilitate comparison (Fig. 7 ). Participants assign each reaction a single score from 1 (very poor) to 5 (very good), jointly considering reaction quality and semantic correspondence to the input cue. Each baseline is evaluated only on its supported modalities. We report average participant ratings separately for each round; MixReact’s scores differ between the two rounds because the user studies are conducted separately, with cues randomly sampled from the test set for each round.
blocks.zh: 我们组织了两个单独的分级周期,用于基线比较和消减研究,这两个周期都由同样的20名参与者评价。 在每轮中,我们随机从测试集中选择每个模式的30个提示,产生90个贯穿文字、音频和视频的提示。 对于每个提示,反应在匿名方法标签下按随机顺序一起呈现,同时同步回放以方便比较(图7. 参与者将每个反应的单分从1分(非常差)到5分(非常好),共同考虑反应质量和语义对应输入提示. 每项基准只根据其支持的模式加以评估。 MixReact的分数在两轮之间有所不同, 因为用户研究是分开进行的,

blocks.en: In the baseline comparison (Fig. 8 ), MixReact receives the highest ratings across all three modalities: 4.22 for text, 4.13 for audio, and 4.17 for video. Its advantages are particularly pronounced for text and audio, where the strongest competing baseline, ReactMotion++ [ 44 ] , scores 2.71 and 2.37, respectively. For video, MixReact also outperforms NOUS++ [ 98 ] , the highest-rated baseline at 3.63. The ablation (Fig. 9 ) further supports the contributions of our design components. Removing the discrete branch produces the largest decline across all modalities, reducing the overall rating from 3.60 to 2.07 and highlighting the importance of discrete behavioral guidance. Replacing one-way mixture attention with bidirectional attention lowers the overall rating to 2.87, supporting the benefit of protecting discrete context from continuous denoising. Removing the continuous branch reduces ratings for audio and video, lowering the overall score to 3.37 and supporting its contribution to detailed state prediction. These results demonstrate the perceptual advantages of MixReact and support the complementary roles of its components in generating high-quality, cue-appropriate reactions.
blocks.zh: 在基线比较(图8)中,MixReact获得所有三种模式的最高收视率:文本为4.22分,音频为4.13分,视频为4.17分. 其优点在文本和音频方面特别明显,其中最强相竞的基准RactMotion++ [44],分别得分为2.71分和2.37分. 对于视频,MixReact也超越了NOUS++ [98],最高评级的基准为3.63. 通货膨胀(图9)进一步支持我们设计部件的贡献。 移除离散分行产生出所有方式中最大的下降,将总体评级从3.60降至2.07并突出离散行为指导的重要性. 以双向关注取代单向混合关注将总体评分降至2.87分,支持保护离散上下文不被持续去名化的好处. 取消连续分会降低音频和视频的收视率,将总分降低到3.37分,并支持其对详细状态预测的贡献. 这些结果显示了MixReact的知觉优势,并支持其组件在产生高质量和相干的反应方面的互补作用.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : User study interface. Participants view the input cue alongside generated reactions from different methods and rate each reaction on a five-point scale, ranging from 1 (very poor) to 5 (very good).
blocks.zh: 图7:用户研究接口. 参与者将输入提示与不同方法产生的反应一并看待,并按从1(非常差)到5(非常好)的五分级对每个反应进行评分。

blocks.en: 10.2 Runtime and Real-time Performance.
blocks.zh: 10.2 运行时和实时性能.

blocks.en:
We evaluate MixReact on a single NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU with FP32 precision.
The discrete branch samples a complete reaction plan and constructs its intermediate-layer key–value caches in 52.47 ms on average. This computation is performed once per reaction, and the resulting caches are reused throughout execution. Conditioned on the cached context, the continuous branch predicts a window of 60 future states in 79.49 ms, corresponding to 12.58 prediction windows per second, or an equivalent generation throughput of 754.8 states per second. At the nominal control frequency of 30 Hz, each window covers 2 s of simulated motion. A new window is generated every 60 control steps, yielding a nominal replanning frequency of 0.5 Hz in simulation time. The initial DisCo-MoT prediction, including discrete-plan preparation and generation of the first future-state window, takes 131.90 ms on average.
blocks.zh:
我们用FP32精度在单NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU上评价MixReact.
离散分支取样一个完整的反应计划,并平均以52.47 ms构建其中间层的键-值缓存. 这种计算每次反应一次进行,产生的缓存在整个执行过程中被再用. 以缓存上下文为条件,连续分支预测出一个以79.49 ms为单位的60个未来状态的窗口,相当于每秒12.58个预测窗口,或相当于每秒754.8个生成的吞吐量. 在名义控制频率为30Hz时,每个窗口覆盖2 s的模拟运动. 每60个控制步骤产生一个新的窗口,在模拟时间中产生0.5赫兹的名义再规划频率. 初步的DisCo-MOT预测,包括离散计划准备和生成第一个未来状态窗口,平均需要131.90 ms.

blocks.en: At each control step, HAT conditions on the latest 16 observed states and the predicted next state to produce an executable action. Its standalone inference latency is 3.39 ms on average, corresponding to a throughput of 294.8 actions per second, well above the nominal 30 Hz control rate.
blocks.zh: 在每一个控制步骤上,最近观察到的16个状态的HAT条件和预测的下一个状态产生可执行动作. 其独立的推论纬度平均为3.39毫秒,相当于吞吐量为每秒294.8个动作,远高于名义上30赫兹的控制率.

blocks.en: To assess closed-loop execution speed, we additionally benchmark the complete closed loop, including DisCo-MoT state prediction, HAT inference, physics simulation, and simulator state feedback. For each modality, we conduct five runs of 100 control steps each. The measured wall-clock throughputs are 34.56, 34.63, and 34.35 control steps per second for text, audio, and video, respectively, with an aggregate throughput of 34.51 steps per second. Relative to the nominal 30 Hz control rate, this corresponds to approximately 1.15 × 1.15\times real-time execution on average.
blocks.zh: 为了评估闭路执行速度,我们额外基准了完整的闭路环,包括DisCo-MoT状态预测,HAT推断,物理模拟,模拟状态反馈. 对于每种方式,我们进行5次运行,每次100个控制步骤. 对文字,音频,视频的测得的壁时吞吐量分别为34.56,34.63和34.35个控制步骤,总吞吐量为34.51个步骤. 相较于名义上30赫兹控制率,这相当于平均约1.15×1.15正时实时执行.

blocks.en: 10.3 One-to-many Reaction Generation.
blocks.zh: 10.3 一对多反应生成.

blocks.en: To further illustrate MixReact’s capacity for one-to-many generation, Fig. 10 presents three reactions to each fixed text, audio, or video cue. The generated reactions exhibit distinct combinations of gestures and postural changes under the same conditioning input. For example, upon receiving the remorseful audio cue, the humanoid may bring its hands toward its face to convey empathetic concern, raise a hand to signal reassurance, or lean forward with outward hand gestures to invite the speaker to elaborate. These alternatives differ in their movement patterns while remaining plausible responses to the shared cue. Across all three modalities, the examples illustrate MixReact’s ability to generate diverse behavioral realizations of a single cue and execute them in physics-based simulation.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步说明MixReact的一对多生成能力,图10对每个固定文本、音频或视频提示给出了三种反应。 产生的反应在相同的条件输入下,表现出不同的手势和姿势变化。 例如,在接到悔恨的音频提示后,人偶可能举起手来表达悲哀的忧虑,举起手来表示保证,或向前靠出手势,请发言者详细阐述。 这些替代品在移动模式上有所不同,而对于共同的提示仍然有合理的反应。 在所有三种模式中,这些例子都说明了MixReact在物理学模拟中生成一个单一提示的不同行为实现并执行它们的能力.

blocks.en: 11 Additional Training and Inference Details
blocks.zh: 11 其他培训和推论细节

blocks.en: 11.1 Training Details of VQ-VAE
blocks.zh: 11.1 VQ-VAE培训详情

blocks.en: We pretrain a VQ-VAE [ 72 ] on humanoid state trajectories to learn the discrete vocabulary used by DisCo-MoT. After excluding sequences shorter than 32 frames, the pretraining corpus comprises 20,188 trajectories from the AMASS [ 47 ] training set, with no trajectory overlap with the test sets used to evaluate MixReact. Each state channel is standardized using statistics computed over the retained frames. We retain the original trajectory lengths and extract 32-frame windows with a stride of one, without temporal resampling.
blocks.zh: 我们预先在人形状态轨迹上训练出一个VQ-VAE[72],以学习DisCo-MoT所使用的离散词汇. 在排除了短于32帧的序列后,预训集由AMASS[47]训练集的20,188个轨迹组成,与用于评价MixReact的测试集没有轨迹重叠. 每个州频道都采用按保留框架计算的统计数据进行标准化。 我们保留了原来的轨迹长度,并提取出32个框架的窗户,并采用一个步道,不进行时间重印.

blocks.en: Following T2M-GPT [ 89 ] , the temporal convolutional encoder has a hidden width of 512 and comprises two downsampling stages. Each stage consists of a stride-2 convolution followed by three residual blocks with dilation rates of 1, 3, and 9. The resulting temporal downsampling factor is κ = 4 \kappa=4 , yielding eight tokens per 32-frame window. Encoder features are quantized through nearest-neighbor assignment to a single codebook containing K = 512 K=512 entries, each of dimension 512. The decoder reconstructs normalized states through dilated residual blocks, nearest-neighbor upsampling, and temporal convolutions.
blocks.zh: 继T2M-GPT [89]后,时间演化编码器的隐藏宽度为512,由两个下取样相组成. 每个阶段都由一个阶地-2相接而来,后有3个残块相接相接而来,膨胀率为1,3和9. 由此产生的时间下取样因子为 $ = 4\kappa= 4,每32帧窗口产生8个令牌. 编码器的特性通过近邻指派到一个包含K = 512 K = 512个条目的单一编码簿中进行定量,每个条目的尺寸为512. 解码器通过稀释后残留块,近邻取样和时间演化来重建正态状态.

blocks.en: Let s s and s ^ \widehat{s} denote the normalized input and reconstructed state windows, respectively, and let f f and f q f_{q} denote the encoder features and their quantized counterparts. The training objective is ℒ VQ = SL 1 ⁡ ( s ^ , s ) + MSE ⁡ ( f , sg ⁡ ( f q ) ) + λ ​ SL 1 ⁡ ( Δ ​ s ^ , Δ ​ s ) , \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{VQ}}=\operatorname{SL}_{1}(\widehat{s},s)+\operatorname{MSE}\!\left(f,\operatorname{sg}(f_{q})\right)+\lambda\,\operatorname{SL}_{1}\!\left(\Delta\widehat{s},\Delta s\right), (11) where SL 1 \operatorname{SL}_{1} denotes the Smooth L1 loss, sg \operatorname{sg} denotes stop-gradient, Δ ​ s t = s t + 1 − s t \Delta s_{t}=s_{t+1}-s_{t} , and λ \lambda is a hyperparameter controlling the weight of the temporal-difference loss. We set λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 . The codebook is updated using exponential moving averages with a decay of 0.99. Entries with an EMA assignment count below one are reinitialized from encoder features in the current batch. The reconstruction term encourages accurate state recovery, the commitment term constrains encoder features to remain close to their assigned code vectors, and the temporal-difference term encourages preservation of frame-to-frame state changes. A straight-through estimator propagates reconstruction gradients through the quantization operation.

blocks.en:
We optimize the encoder and decoder for 100 epochs, corresponding to 723,800 optimization steps, with a batch size of 512. We use AdamW [ 43 ] with a constant learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.99 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.99) , and zero weight decay. The global gradient norm is clipped to 1.0.
After pretraining, the tokenizer is frozen and used to encode complete trajectories into discrete state tokens that supervise the discrete branch. During MixReact inference, the discrete Transformer samples a complete reaction plan and caches keys and values from its intermediate layers to guide continuous state prediction. The continuous branch predicts future states directly; neither the VQ-VAE encoder nor its decoder is invoked during standard online generation.
blocks.zh:
我们优化了100个纪元的编码和解码器,对应723,800个优化步骤,分批大小为512个. 我们使用 AdamW [43] , 持续学习率为 2×10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4}, (β 1, β 2) = (0.9, 0.99) (\β 1},\β+2}) = (0.9, 0.99), 零重量衰减. 全球梯度规范被剪接到1.0.
经过预训后,活化剂被冷冻并被用来将完整的轨迹编码为监督离散分支的离散状态活化物. 在MixReact推断期间,离散变形器对一个完整的反应计划进行样本,并从它的中间层中缓存键和值来指导连续态预测. 连续分支直接预言未来状态;在标准在线生成过程中,VQ-VAE编码器及其解码器都不被引用.

blocks.en: 11.2 Training details of MixReact
blocks.zh: 11.2 混合反应的培训细节

blocks.en: We extract cue features using frozen pretrained encoders. For text, we retain 768-dimensional token features from the text Transformer of CLIP ViT-L/14@336px [ 58 ] . AudioCLIP [ 18 ] extracts a descriptor from mono audio resampled to 44.1 kHz and center-cropped or zero-padded to 5 s. For video, TC-CLIP [ 31 ] , built on ViT-B/16 [ 10 ] , jointly encodes 16 uniformly sampled frames resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 , yielding 512-dimensional frame-level features. MCA maps these features through modality-specific adapters of width 512 and a shared projection to construct the 384-dimensional semantic memory C C . Each sample uses one cue modality, with padding and inactive modality slots masked out. MCA is optimized exclusively by the discrete masked-modeling objective, while the continuous branch accesses C C with stopped gradients.
blocks.zh: 我们用被冷冻的预导编码器提取提示特性。 对于文本,我们保留了CLIP VIT-L/14@336px [58] 文本变形器中的768维符号特性. AudioCLIP [18] 从单声道重印到44.1 kHz并取出一个描述器,中间被克或零加成到5 s. 对于视频,基于Vit-B/16 [10]的TC-CLIP [31] 联合编码16个统一取样的帧被调整为224×224/224\times 224,生成了512维帧级特征. MCA通过宽度为512的特有模式适配器和用于构建384维语义内存 C. 每个样本都使用一个提示模式,同时将粘贴和不活动模式插槽遮住. MCA完全由离散的遮盖模型目标来优化,而连续的分支通过停止梯度访问C C.

blocks.en: For each cue–reaction pair, a frozen modality-specific encoder extracts cue features, which MCA maps to semantic memory C C . Both branches access C C through condition cross-attention. Complete state trajectories are tokenized offline by the frozen VQ-VAE [ 72 ] , using the normalization established during its pretraining.
blocks.zh: 对于每个 cue – 反应配对, 一个被冻结模式特定编码器会提取 cue 特性, MCA 将其映射为语义记忆 C C. 两个分支通过条件交叉调取C. 完整的状态轨迹通过被冻结的VQ-VAE [72] 下线表示,使用在其预训期间确立的常态.

blocks.en: Each epoch consists of two sequential optimization passes. In the discrete pass, tokens are independently masked with probability 0.5, and the discrete branch predicts their original identities conditioned on the visible tokens and C C . Cross-entropy loss over masked positions updates the discrete branch and MCA.
blocks.zh: 每个纪元由两个相继的优化通过组成. 在离散通路口中,信使被独立地用概率为0.5来掩盖,而离散分会预测其原始身份以可见信使和C. 被遮住的姿势上的相通性损失更新了离散分行和MCA.

blocks.en: In the continuous pass, we extract 30-frame history windows and up to 60 future frames from the original trajectories. Each window retains its source trajectory’s complete ground-truth token sequence Z Z . A separate forward pass through the discrete branch processes the unmasked Z Z and the same semantic memory C C , without gradient computation, to construct intermediate-layer key–value caches. The continuous branch receives Gaussian-corrupted future states and accesses these caches through one-way mixture attention. Within this attention mechanism, continuous queries attend jointly to discrete and continuous keys and values, while discrete queries are restricted to discrete tokens. The continuous branch also attends separately to the clean history and C C , and predicts normalized clean future states using a mean squared error loss over valid frames. Both the discrete caches and C C are detached, so this pass updates only the continuous branch.
blocks.zh: 在连续的通路中,我们从原来的轨迹中取出30帧历史窗口和多达60个未来帧. 每个窗口保留其源轨迹的完整地-真实符号序列Z Z. 一个单独的前向通过离散分支进程,解析出 Z Z 和同一种语义内存 C C ,不进行梯度计算,以构建中层密钥-值缓存. 连续分支接收了高斯被腐蚀的未来状态,并通过单向混合注意力访问这些缓存. 在这一关注机制内,连续的查询共同处理离散和连续的密钥和值,而离散查询则仅限于离散的符号. 连续分行还分别处理干净历史和C C ,并预测正常的清洁未来状态使用平均平方误差损失超过有效框架. 离散缓存和C都脱落了,因此此通取只更新了连续分支.

blocks.en: Given a cue, MCA constructs C C , and the discrete branch starts from a fully masked token sequence. Over eight sampling rounds, it commits sampled tokens at randomly selected unresolved positions while retaining previously committed tokens. The completed sequence Z ^ \widehat{Z} undergoes an additional forward pass to construct key–value caches, which remain fixed throughout execution. We initialize the humanoid in a stationary standing pose and repeat its observed initial state to populate the history buffers. Conditioned on C C , the cached discrete context, and the normalized 30-frame execution history, the continuous branch generates a window of up to 60 future states from Gaussian noise through 10 denoising steps. These predictions are denormalized and supplied sequentially to HAT. At each control step, HAT combines the corresponding predicted next state with the latest 16 observed states to generate an executable action. Simulator feedback updates both history buffers, and a new future window is generated every 60 control steps while reusing the same discrete context. Thus, subsequent predictions and actions depend on the states actually reached during execution.
blocks.zh: 由于一个提示,MCA构建了 C C, 离散的分支从一个被完全遮住的符号序列开始. 它在8个抽样回合中,在随机选定的未解决位置上进行抽样标记,同时保留先前承诺的标记。 完成的序列 Z ^\ gladhat{Z} 需要经过额外的前传来构建密钥- 值缓存, 在整个执行过程中这些密钥仍然固定 。 我们以固定姿势初始化人造物,并重复其观测到的初始状态来充斥历史缓冲. 以 C C 为条件,缓存的离散上下文,以及正常化的30个帧执行历史,连续分支通过10个去诺步骤,从高斯语噪声中产生出一个最多60个未来状态的窗口. 这些预测是非正常的,并依次提供给HAT. 在每个控制步骤上,HAT将相应的预测下状态与最新的16个被观测到的状态合并,生成可执行动作. 模拟反馈更新了两个历史缓冲,每60个控制步骤都会生成一个新的未来窗口,同时重用相同的离散上下文. 因此,随后的预测和行动取决于执行期间实际达到的状态.

blocks.en: We train DisCo-MoT on three NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPUs with 24 GB memory each. Both branches use a global batch size of 3,072 (1,024 per GPU), comprising cue–motion records for discrete training and state windows for continuous training. Separate AdamW optimizers [ 43 ] use constant learning rates of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} and 10 − 4 10^{-4} and weight decay of 0.01 and 0 for the discrete and continuous branches, respectively, with ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999) . We train DisCo-MoT for a total of 150 epochs, corresponding to 1,650 and 11,930 optimizer updates for the discrete and continuous branches, respectively. The continuous branch performs 10 DDPM denoising steps with a cosine noise schedule [ 51 ] . We further apply classifier-free guidance [ 21 ] , where cue conditioning is retained during discrete training and dropped with probability 0.1 during continuous training, and a guidance scale of 2.5 is used during diffusion sampling.
blocks.zh: 我们在三台NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU上训练DisCo-MoT,每台有24GB内存. 两个分支都使用3,072个全球批量大小(每GPU为1,024个),包括离散训练的提示-运动记录和持续训练的状态窗口。 分立的亚当W优化器[43]使用2×10−4 2\times 10×4 和10×4 10×4 的常数学习率,离散分枝和连续分枝的重量衰减率分别为0.01和0,其中(β 1,β 2)=(0.9, 0.999)(\β 1},\β2})=(0.9,0.999). 我们训练DisCo-MoT共计150个纪元,分别对应1,650个和11,930个离散分支和连续分支的优化更新. 连续分支执行10个DDPM去声步骤并有同位素噪声表 [51]. 我们进一步采用无分级器指导[21] ,在离散训练中保留起子调制,在持续训练中以概率0.1降低起子调制,在扩散取样中采用2.5分分级制导。

blocks.en: We train HAT on eight NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPUs with 24 GB memory each. Each GPU runs 6,912 parallel simulation environments, yielding a global batch size of 55,296 online samples per update. HAT comprises four Transformer blocks with a hidden dimension of 512, eight attention heads, and dropout of 0.1. It takes a 16-frame history of 358-dimensional states and the next reference state as inputs and predicts a 69-dimensional action. Online distillation [ 61 ] uses a frozen PHC teacher [ 45 ] and 20,188 reference motions from AMASS [ 47 ] sampled at 30 FPS, with no reference-motion overlap with our MixReact evaluation test sets. At each control step, the teacher provides action supervision at the states visited by HAT, while the simulator executes HAT’s own predicted actions. We minimize the action mean squared error for 212,000 optimizer updates using AdamW [ 43 ] with a constant learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999) , and weight decay of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} . Bias, normalization, positional, and query parameters are exempt from weight decay, and the global gradient norm is clipped to 1.0. After distillation, HAT remains frozen during DisCo-MoT training and inference.
blocks.zh: 我们在8个NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU上训练HAT,每个有24GB内存. 每个GPU运行着6,912个平行的模拟环境,每次更新时产生的全球批量大小为55,296个在线样本. blocks.en: We construct cue-associated trajectories from ReactMotionNet [ 44 ] for text and audio cues and ViMo [ 86 ] for video cues. Reference motions are tracked in simulation using PHC [ 45 ] , yielding humanoid state sequences and corresponding control actions. We retain only trajectories satisfying PHC’s tracking success criteria to obtain high-quality, physically plausible expert demonstrations. Each retained state–action sequence is linked to its original cue annotations through motion identifiers, forming sequence-level state–action–condition triplets. We preserve the original dataset splits and retain training pairs with successfully tracked trajectories. The resulting training corpus comprises 29,615 ReactMotionNet records and 2,800 ViMo pairs, spanning 2,477 distinct trajectories and 421,957 state frames. Within this corpus, ReactMotionNet explicitly represents one-to-many cue–reaction associations by pairing speaker utterances with candidate listener motions annotated with graded appropriateness. We retain its Gold and Silver annotations, obtaining 29,515 distinct cue–motion pairs across 6,624 cue groups, with an average of 4.46 reference reactions per cue. Each record provides textual and auditory conditions associated with the same trajectory, and both modalities share these one-to-many associations. For video conditioning, we use ViMo, which provides one annotated reaction per video despite the underlying ambiguity of visual reaction generation: a friendly approach, for example, may elicit waving, handshaking, or hugging. Accordingly, ReactMotionNet explicitly supplies multiple reference reactions per cue, whereas ViMo provides a single reference for a task that admits diverse plausible reactions. Physical evaluation uses the same 696 test-set conditions and fixed Gold references from ReactMotionNet for both text- and audio-driven reactions, and 700 test-set conditions from ViMo for video-driven reactions.

We evaluate reaction distribution quality, diversity, and physical consistency on simulated executions, retaining all valid frames, including those following a fall. FID, Diversity, and MModality are computed from features extracted by a frozen state encoder trained following the evaluator training protocol adopted in HERO [ 86 ] . Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) measures the distributional discrepancy between generated and Phys-GT reactions. Diversity measures the average feature distance between randomly sampled motion pairs and is assessed relative to reference diversity, whereas MultiModality (MModality) measures pairwise feature distances between reactions generated from the same cue. Physical metrics are computed from simulated rigid-body positions. Floating measures the mean positive excess of the lowest rigid-body origin above a 5 mm ground-clearance threshold. Skating measures the average horizontal displacement of the toe rigid bodies over adjacent-frame intervals in which the same toe remains at or below 50 mm in both frames. Jerk measures the mean norm of third-order finite differences of rigid-body positions. Fall rate is the percentage of trajectories whose actual pelvis height falls below 0.5 ​ m 0.5\,\mathrm{m} at any frame, with each trajectory counted at most once under this height-based criterion.

blocks.en: We adapt CLoSD [ 69 ] to support text-, audio-, and video-driven reactions within a shared model. We replace DiP’s text-conditioning interface with trainable modality-specific adapters and a shared projection, using features extracted by the same frozen encoders as MixReact. The resulting conditioning tokens are supplied through cross-attention with padding masks, with one active modality per sample. We jointly train DiP and the adapters from scratch on ReactMotionNet [ 44 ] and ViMo [ 86 ] cue–motion pairs, retaining the original 263-dimensional HumanML3D representation [ 16 ] and diffusion objective. We further fine-tune CLoSD’s PHC-based tracking controller [ 45 ] using its native training pipeline. Generated motions are converted into reference trajectories through CLoSD’s native representation pipeline and executed by the fine-tuned controller, while actual simulation history provides the prefix for subsequent predictions. Apart from the multimodal conditioning interface and reaction training data, we follow CLoSD’s official training and inference implementation, retaining its original hyperparameters and model configurations.

blocks.en: We retain the same data splits, modality features, and frozen HAT controller across ablation variants. w/o Discrete branch removes the discrete Transformer, masked-token objective, and discrete key–value context. The continuous branch and MCA are trained jointly from scratch, with future states conditioned on the cue and execution history. w/o Continuous branch reuses the trained discrete generator of our full model and decodes its sampled token sequence into state references through the frozen VQ-VAE, without additional training. These references remain fixed throughout execution, while HAT continues to use observed history for closed-loop control. w/o One-way mixture attention retains both branches but allows their queries to attend jointly to discrete and continuous keys and values, removes cross-branch stop-gradients, and jointly optimizes both branches. Two aligned forward passes compute masked-token cross-entropy and clean-state reconstruction loss, respectively. The former uses masked ground-truth tokens, whereas the latter uses complete, unmasked tokens as discrete context. Both passes share the same noisy future window and history. Both optimizers are updated during the full-sequence and window-based training stages. At inference, sampled token identities remain fixed, but both branches recompute their features at every denoising step because the discrete features now depend on the evolving continuous states.

blocks.en: The bidirectional variant allows both branches to attend to the combined discrete and continuous keys and values and jointly optimizes them without cross-branch stop-gradients. Although the sampled token identities remain fixed during inference, their intermediate representations depend on the evolving noisy state windows. During training, the diffusion objective also updates the discrete branch, exposing global behavioral representations to local reconstruction gradients. Our one-way design restricts discrete queries to discrete keys and values and blocks diffusion gradients through the discrete caches and semantic memory. This preserves the independence of full-sequence behavioral modeling while allowing discrete context to guide continuous state prediction.
blocks.zh: 双向变体使两个分支都能够关注结合的离散和连续的键和值,并共同优化它们而无跨分支的停止分级. 虽然在推论中被抽样的象征身份仍然固定,但其中间的表示依赖于不断演变的吵闹状态窗口. 在培训期间,传播目标还更新了离散分支,将全球行为表现暴露于局部重建梯度. 我们的单向设计通过离散缓存和语义内存将离散的查询限制在离散的密钥和值以及块扩散梯度上. 这保持了全序行为模型的独立性,同时允许离散上下文来指导连续状态预测.

blocks.en: Tab. 3 of the main paper supports this design: bidirectional coupling yields higher FID and jerk across all three modalities, with jerk approximately doubling for text and audio. It also increases floating and skating errors for text- and audio-driven reactions, indicating poorer contact consistency. The visual results provide complementary evidence: in the video example, the bidirectional variant loses balance and falls, whereas MixReact maintains balance throughout the reaction (Fig. 6 of the main paper, fourth and first columns, respectively). The user study further supports these findings (Fig. 9 ). Replacing one-way mixture attention with bidirectional coupling lowers the overall rating from 3.60 to 2.87, with decreases across all three modalities and the largest decline for video, from 4.20 to 3.20. These ratings reflect participants’ joint assessment of reaction quality and cue correspondence, showing that the benefits extend to perceived reaction quality. Collectively, the quantitative, visual, and perceptual results support protecting global behavioral representations from interference by local continuous denoising, so that fine-grained state prediction remains guided by a consistent representation of the whole reaction.
blocks.zh: 主论文的分页3支持这种设计:双向耦合产生更高的FID和所有三种模式的自摸,而文本和音频的自摸大约翻了一番。 它还会为文本和音频驱动的反应而增加浮动和花样滑冰出错,表明接触一致性较差. 视觉结果提供了补充证据:在视频实例中,双向变体会失去平衡和下降,而MixReact则在整个反应中保持平衡(正文图6,第四和第一列分别). 用户研究进一步支持了这些调查结果(图9)。 用双向耦合取代单向混合关注,将总体评级从3.60降至2.87,所有三种模式都有所下降,视频的下降幅度最大,从4.20降至3.20。 这些评分反映了参与者对反应质量和提示对应的联合评估,表明其好处延伸到了感知的反应质量. 集体而言,定量,视觉,和感知的结果支持保护全球行为表征不受局部持续去诺的干扰,因此精细的分泌状态预测仍然以整个反应的一致表示为导向.

blocks.en: The different ablation trends are consistent with differences in the cue–reaction associations represented by the two datasets. ReactMotionNet [ 44 ] pairs identical text or audio cues with multiple behaviorally distinct reactions, introducing heterogeneous alternatives under the same condition. As shown in Tab. 3 of the main paper, the continuous-only variant exhibits higher FID and lower multimodality than the discrete-only variant, consistent with a greater tendency toward behavioral collapse under explicit one-to-many supervision. Discrete modeling provides an explicit mechanism for selecting among these alternatives and preserving the selected reaction throughout generation. In contrast, ViMo [ 86 ] provides a single annotated reaction per video, with related scenarios represented by similar but distinct visual cues. Consequently, its annotations do not explicitly associate each individual cue with multiple heterogeneous targets. On this dataset, the continuous-only variant achieves a slightly lower FID than the discrete-only variant, suggesting a benefit from predicting states directly rather than reconstructing them from discrete tokens. This observation is consistent with the continuous branch bypassing quantization-induced reconstruction errors while retaining history-conditioned adaptation during execution. These dataset-dependent trends motivate the complementary design of DisCo-MoT: discrete context supports distinct behavioral choices, while continuous prediction preserves fine-grained state information and adapts execution details. Their combination achieves the lowest FID among the evaluated variants across all three cue modalities while maintaining competitive physical consistency.
blocks.zh: 不同的衰减趋势与两个数据集所代表的提示-反应关联的不同一致. React MotionNet [44] 对等文本或音频提示具有多种行为上截然不同的反应,在相同条件下引入了多样的替代品. 如塔布所显示. 主要论文第3篇中,仅持续变体显示出比单离散变体更高的FID和更低的多模式性,这与在明确的一对多监管下出现行为崩溃的更大倾向是一致的。 分明的建模为在这些替代品中进行选择和在一代人中保持选定的反应提供了明确机制。 相形之下,ViMo[86]每段视频提供单一的注解反应,相关情景以相类似但截然不同的视觉提示来表示. 因此,其说明没有明确将每个提示与多种不同的目标联系起来。 在这个数据集上,仅持续变体实现比仅离散变体略低的FID,说明直接预测状态而不是从离散的符号来重建状态的好处. 这种观察与连续分支绕过量化引起的重建错误是一致的,同时保留了执行过程中的历史条件适应. 这些依赖数据集的趋势激励了DisCo-MoT的互补设计:离散上下文支持不同的行为选择,而连续预测则保留了精细的状态信息并适应了执行细节. 它们的组合在所有三种提示模式的被评价变种中实现了最低的FID,同时保持了竞争性的物理一致性。

blocks.en: 14 Analysis of One-to-Many Generation
blocks.zh: 14 对一对多代的分析

blocks.en: Diffusion models can represent multimodal conditional distributions [ 20 , 70 ] , and continuous representations do not inherently lead to averaged behaviors. Our setting nevertheless poses a distinct challenge: everyday cues leave the intended reaction unspecified and can elicit behaviorally distinct responses [ 86 , 44 ] . For example, “Congratulations!” may prompt a bow, a handshake, or a celebratory jump. These alternatives differ in their overall behavioral structure, extending beyond variations in the execution of a specified action. Generating appropriate physics-based reactions therefore requires both selecting among these alternatives and maintaining the selected behavior throughout physical execution.
blocks.zh: 分泌模型可以代表多模式有条件的分泌[20,70],而连续表示本身不会导致平均行为. 然而,我们所处的环境带来了一个独特的挑战:每天的提示都未指明预期的反应,并可以引起行为上不同的反应[86、44]。 例如,“恭喜!”可能会引发弓箭、握手或庆祝跳伞。 这些替代品在整体行为结构上有所不同,超越了特定动作执行中的变化. 因此,产生适当的基于物理的反应,既需要在这些替代办法中选择,也需要在整个物理执行过程中保持选定的行为。

blocks.en: Autoregressive motion diffusion generates successive motion segments conditioned on recent history and external inputs [ 69 , 94 ] . In our continuous-only variant, behavioral choice remains implicit in local denoising conditioned on the cue and execution history. We hypothesize that this formulation makes reaction selection and persistence more difficult when heterogeneous behaviors share similar initial states. Recent history describes what has already occurred but may not sufficiently specify how the complete reaction should unfold. DisCo-MoT addresses this ambiguity by sampling a complete discrete reaction plan and retaining its context across prediction windows. The continuous branch then predicts detailed future states under this persistent guidance while adapting to observed execution history.
blocks.zh: 自动后向运动扩散产生相接运动段,以近代历史和外部输入为条件[69,94]. 在我们的连续的变体中,行为选择 仍然隐含在局部的去名 条件在提示和执行历史。 我们假设,这种配方使反应选择和持久性更加困难,因为不同的行为有着相似的初始状态。 最近的历史描述了已经发生的事情,但可能没有充分说明整个反应应如何展开。 DisCo-MoT通过取样一个完整的离散反应计划并保留其整个预测窗口的上下文来解决这一模糊性. 然后,连续分支在这个持续的指导下预测详细的未来状态,同时适应所观察到的执行历史.

blocks.en: The ablation results in Tab. 3 of the main paper support this design. Removing the discrete branch reduces MModality from 1.320 to 1.001 for text, from 1.324 to 0.816 for audio, and from 1.244 to 1.101 for video, while worsening FID across all three modalities. Thus, reduced conditional diversity is accompanied by poorer distributional fidelity. These findings support explicit whole-reaction modeling as a useful complement to local continuous prediction in our task. The benefit of DisCo-MoT lies in organizing reaction generation around persistent global behavioral context while retaining diffusion’s capacity for fine-grained continuous generation.
blocks.zh: 通融结果出自"塔布". 主要论文中3篇支持这一设计. 取消离散分会将文本的MModity从1.320减为1.001;音频从1.324减为0.816;视频从1.244减为1.101;同时所有三种模式的FID都恶化了。 因此,随着有条件多样性的减少,分配忠诚度也更差。 这些结论支持明确的整体反应模型,作为对我们任务中当地持续预测的有益补充。 DisCo-MoT的好处在于围绕持续的全球行为背景组织反应生成,同时保留扩散的精细连续生成能力.

blocks.en: 15 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 15 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: MixReact currently generates reactions in physics-based simulation without explicitly modeling the spatial relationships and contact requirements between the humanoid and the entities depicted in the cue. For example, a petting gesture elicited by a dog video does not account for the animal’s relative position or enforce appropriate hand–animal contact. Extending reaction generation to physically grounded interactions requires integrating scene geometry, interaction targets, and contact constraints into planning and control. Such an extension would allow the same reaction intent to be realized through motions adapted to different target locations and environmental configurations. Deployment on real humanoids additionally introduces challenges involving perception uncertainty and differences between simulated and real dynamics. Future work could investigate domain randomization and online adaptation to improve robustness to sensing errors and dynamics mismatch.
blocks.zh: MixReact目前是在基于物理的模拟中产生反应的,而没有明确模拟人与提示所描绘的实体之间的空间关系和接触要求. 例如,由狗视频所引发的宠物手势并不能说明动物的相对位置或实施适当的手-动物接触。 将反应生成扩展到物理上基础的相互作用,需要将场景几何,相互作用目标,和接触限制纳入规划和控制. 这样的扩展将允许通过适应不同目标地点和环境配置的运动实现同样的反应意图。 部署在真人类上,还带来了涉及认知不确定性和模拟动态与实际动态差异的挑战。 今后的工作可以调查域随机化和在线调整,以更有力地应对感知出错和动态错配.

blocks.en: Although MixReact supports text, audio, and video conditioning within a unified framework, each reaction is generated from a single cue modality. Joint conditioning across all three modalities is limited by the datasets used in this work, which do not provide jointly annotated text, audio, and video cues for the same reaction. Future work could address this limitation by collecting high-quality reaction datasets with synchronized multimodal cues, enabling models to integrate complementary signals and adapt their reactions as new information becomes available. Such datasets should also capture multiple plausible reactions to the same multimodal context, preserving the inherent diversity of human responses. Learning to resolve conflicting cues and update ongoing behavior would further extend MixReact toward continuous interaction in dynamic environments.
blocks.zh: 虽然MixReact在一个统一的框架中支持文本,音频,视频的调制,但每个反应都是由单一的提示模式产生的. 跨越所有三种模式的联合调制均受本作所使用数据集的限制,这些数据集不为同一种反应提供附加注释的文本,音频和视频提示. 今后的工作可以通过收集具有同步多模式提示的高质量反应数据集来应对这一局限性,使模型能够结合互补信号,并随着新信息的出现而调整其反应。 这种数据集还应反映对同一多式环境的多种合理反应,保持人类反应的固有多样性。 学会解决相冲突的提示并更新进行中的行为会将MixReact进一步扩大到动态环境中的持续互动.
